projects.name: CipherRisk
projects.description: CipherRisk is an institutional-grade risk assessment platform leveraging Fhenix fhEVM's Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) to address Web3 financial doxxing by enabling complex, native computation on encrypted data [1.1]. By processing leverage ratios and net asset values while keeping proprietary inputs hidden from public validators and front-runners, the platform provides a secure alternative to transparent blockchains [1.1]. Utilizing EIP-712 cryptographic signatures for user-authorized decryption, CipherRisk offers a private, verifiable, and composable solution for on-chain financial analytics
